==About==

Crafting {{i|Wildberry Pie}} at a {{i|Baking Table}} will make an {{i|Unbaked Wildberry Pie}} which can then be baked in a {{i|Bread Oven}} to produce a Wildberry Pie. Preparing Foods on a Baking Table removes a small amount of [[Insanity]] and has a chance of giving you an {{i|Eloped Gingerbread Man}}. When baking Foods in a Bread Oven there is a chance for them to become {{i|Animal Crackers}} instead. Right-clicking a Wildberry Pie with the [[Baking]] Skill learned and selecting "Slice" will divide your Pie into 8x {{i|Slice of Pie}}s. When Slicing Pie there is small chance to receive a {{i|Little Jack Horner's Thumbnail}}.
{{Notice|WARNING!| Finding a Little Jack Horner's Thumbnail in your Pie adds a great deal of [[Insanity]].}}
